segments: In the 151 and 50th year of Demetrius,
the son of Seleucus, departed from Rome
and came up with a few men unto a city
of the seacoast and reigned there.
As he entered into the palace of his
ancestors, so it was that his forces had
taken Antiochus and Lysias to bring them
unto him. Wherefore, when he knew it, he
said, "Let me not see their faces."
So, his host slew them.
Now, when Demetrius was set up on the
house upon the throne of his kingdom,
there came unto him all the wicked and
ungodly men of Israel having Alcimus,
who was desirous to be high priest for
their cap
Oh, great king, Judas and his brethren
have slain all our friends and driven us
own land. Now, therefore, send some man
who thou trustest
and let him go and see what havoc he
hath made among us and in the king's
land. Let him punish them with all them
with that aided them.
I have a great man in mind. He is well
known in my kingdom. I will call
Bacchides Alcimus. I will make you a
high priest and I will send Bacchides
with you to take vengeance on the
children of Israel.
parted and came with a great power into
the land of Judea, where they sent
messengers to Judas and his brethren
with peaceable words deceitfully.
But, they gave no heed to their words,
for they saw that they were come with a
great power.
Now, the Scythians were the first among
the children of Israel that sought peace
of them.
One that is a priest of the seed of
Aaron is come with his army
and he will do us no wrong.
We come to do you no harm
neither you or your friends.
Alcimus and Bacchides slew them all in
one day. This brought dread upon the
people. The people said, "There is no
truth or righteousness in them. They
broke their covenant."
Call all of the people who have forsaken
me. I WILL SLAY THEM
AND THROW THEM IN THIS PIT.
AS A MATTER OF FACT, BRING OTHERS AS
WELL. I will make an example out of
them.
Antiochus did just that. Now, when Judas
saw all the mischief that Alcimus and
his company had done among the
Israelites, even above the heathen, he
went out into all the coasts of Judea
round about and took vengeance of them
that had revolted from him, so that they
durst no more go forth into the country.
Bring me Nicanor. He is one of my
honorable princes and I know he had a
deadly hate for Israel. I command you to
destroy the people of Israel.
So, Nicanor came to Jerusalem with a
great force and sent unto Judas and his
brethren deceitfully with friendly words
saying,
Tell your leader, Judas,
I, Nicanor, come in peace. I only
brought a few men with me that I may see
you in peace. Let there be no battle
between you and I.
He came therefore to Judas and they
saluted one another peaceably. Howbeit,
the enemies were prepared to take away
Judas by violence.
Which thing after it was known to Judas
to wit, that he came unto him with
deceit, and he was sore afraid of him
and he would see his face no more.
Nicanor also, when he saw that his
counsel was discovered, went out to
fight against Judas beside Capharsalama,
where there was slain of Nicanor's side
about 5,000 men and the rest fled into
the city of David. After this, went
Nicanor up to Mount Zion and there came
out of the sanctuary certain of the
priests and certain of the elders of the
people to salute him peaceably and to
show him the burnt sacrifice that was
offered for the king.
You fake priest, I am going to destroy
everything you know. Ask your God to
save you from me unless Judas and his
men are delivered to me. I will come and
burn your sanctuary down.
pitched in Adasa with 3,000 men and
prayed to the Lord saying,
O Lord, when that was sent from the king
of the Assyrians blasphemed, thy angel
went out and smote 185,000
of them. Even so, destroy thou this host
before us this day that the rest may
know that he has spoken blasphemously
against thy sanctuary and judge thou him
according to his wickedness.
13th day of the month Adar, the host
joined battle. But, Nicanor's host was
discomfited
and he himself was first slain in
battle. Whereupon, they came forth out
of all the towns of Judea round about
and closed them in, so that they,
turning back upon them that pursued
them, were all slain with the sword and
not one of them was left. Afterwards,
they took the spoils and the prey and
smote off Nicanor's head and his right
hand, which he which he stretched out so
proudly and brought them away and hanged
them up towards Jerusalem. For this
cause, the people rejoiced greatly and
they kept that day a day of great
gladness.
Moreover, they ordained to keep yearly
this day, being the 13th of Adar.
Thus, the land of Judah was in rest a
little while.
